iMocha Integrates with SmartRecruiters to Bring Skills Intelligence to Hiring
Seamless integration brings skills assessments and AI interviews directly into the SmartRecruiters hiring workflow.
Claymont, Delaware, July 23, 2026
- iMocha, a leading AI-powered Skills Intelligence and Work Intelligence platform, today announced an integration with SmartRecruiters, a leading talent acquisition suite. The integration embeds iMocha's skills assessments and AI-led interviews directly into the SmartRecruiters hiring workflow, giving organizations objective visibility into candidate skills earlier in the hiring process.
What the Integration Is
SmartRecruiters manages the hiring workflow, requisitions, candidate pipelines, and collaboration between recruiters and hiring managers. Through this integration, iMocha adds a layer of skills-based evaluation on top of that workflow, without asking recruiters to leave the platform they already use. Recruiters attach an iMocha skills assessment to any role directly in SmartRecruiters. As candidates apply and are shortlisted, their assessment results and AI interview outcomes sync back into the candidate profile, sitting alongside the resume and application history recruiters already work from.
Who It Benefits, and How
Built for talent acquisition teams and hiring managers who want to move beyond resume screening and keyword matching, the integration delivers:
Faster time-to-hire
- Validating skills earlier in the funnel reduces the volume of unqualified candidates reaching later interview stages.
Better quality of hire
- Shortlisting decisions are based on validated skills data rather than resume language or recruiter intuition alone.
Fairer, more consistent screening
- Every candidate for a role is measured against the same benchmark, supported by AI-proctored assessments.
Higher recruiter efficiency
- AI-led conversational interviews handle early-stage evaluation at scale, reducing scheduling and interview workload.
A stronger candidate experience
- Candidates are evaluated on demonstrated capability, through a single, self-contained step within the application journey they already expect.
SmartRecruiters continues to serve as the system of record, managing the hiring process end to end. iMocha adds the skills intelligence that informs the decisions made within it.
Learn More

https://www.imocha.io/smartrecruiters-with-imocha
About iMocha
iMocha is a global AI-powered Skills and Work Intelligence platform that helps organizations execute a skills-first strategy across hiring, workforce readiness, internal mobility, and continuous learning at scale. Its Skills AI agents form a closed-loop system - inferring skills from resumes, certifications, and work data, validating them through assessments and conversational AI interviews, and delivering structured insights that drive smarter talent decisions at scale. Underpinned by an AI-driven skills taxonomy and ontology, iMocha gives organizations a continuously accurate view of their skills and talent landscape.
iMocha is an invisible layer that fits seamlessly into existing stacks through integrations with leading HCMs (SAP SuccessFactors, Workday), learning platforms (Udemy, Degreed, Cornerstone On Demand), and ATS solutions (iCIMS, Greenhouse, and more). For more information, visit
www.imocha.io
About SmartRecruiters
SmartRecruiters is a talent acquisition platform built to help organizations hire at scale. Its SmartOS platform, together with Winston, its embedded AI hiring companion, supports the full hiring journey from attracting and sourcing candidates through selection and onboarding. SmartRecruiters supports thousands of organizations across more than 120 countries, helping talent teams attract, select, and hire talent faster and more efficiently.
